selection_note: Independent additive read-map review; source-specific dictionaries and conditions retained

gates.meaning: Use this edition only for an exact listed model/ID and keep its literal earliest-firmware token. SUN5000 models are not in this edition table. PSC110 is not normalized to SPC110 and no generic string/numeric firmware ordering is defined.
PV-string and MPPT counts are distinct fields. Expose only channels applicable to the exact model/topology; do not infer connected/producing inputs from table coverage.
For the first two pairs: mask14 bit9=0 means PV labels; if bit9=1, referenced 30205 display mode 0 means PV, mode1 means MPPT.

32066 is grid voltage for L/N, UW for L1/L2/N or L1/L2; 32067/32068/32071 and current B/C are invalid for those modes. 32069/32070 invalid for L/N, become UO/WO in split modes and are not displayed off-grid. 32072 is grid current in single/split modes.
Published alarm bits have module conditions. Valid absence of an alarm does not indicate hardware absence; a raised module-specific alarm is fault evidence, not healthy capability/online proof.
PID rows require exact model/context; several source scopes specify PID-reported single-level scenarios. No presence/online bitmap mapping is supplied here.
Support30207 and presence30209 are separate Bitfield32 fields, but bit identities are missing; preserve raw fields and capability unknown.
Internal runtime, temperature/DCI/leakage/bus rows are tagged inspection/R&D recording. Do not promote every diagnostic channel to installed components or safety conclusions.
Read the complete declared field length; 35300 and35304 are each four-register byte blocks. This is field-integrity guidance, not a source claim of atomicity across separate fields.
Retain current/previous hour/day/month/year and corresponding timestamp meanings. Reset, rollover and period timezone are not specified here.

functional_classes.rule: Model, serial, product code, software/hardware identities and registration metadata are string fields. OEM labeling identifies the inverter/OEM entity, not an attached meter or battery.
U32 opaque protocol-version value; source distinguishes high/main and low/revision portions and gives baseline 0x00080000.
U16 identifier matching the supported-model table, not a scaled physical measurement.
U16 counts at 30071 and 30072, explicit gain 1.

Rated power and fixed nameplate capacities differ from current Pmax/Smax and reactive adjustment limits. 30075 references 42027; 30077 references 42025. Reactive bounds can vary with grid-code/derating state.
Raw U16 IDs/version sequences; they describe software/grid-code/OEM identity, not telemetry magnitudes.
U16 count of upgrade packages, gain 1.
Ten U32 descriptors identify package/file and device types using high/low portions.
30207 and 30209 are separately named support and presence Bitfield32 fields.
32000/32002/32003 are status bitfields with distinct remote/monitor/power roles.
Three Bitfield16 alarm words map to the 41 published bits in section 6.1.
Raw U16 CRC16 of the device serial supports distinguishing energy sources at a reused address.
I16 voltages/currents at 32016..32019; labels can denote PV strings or MPPT channels.
Four additional voltage/current pairs are listed at 32020..32027.
I32 DC power, gain 1000 kW.
U16 voltage channels; topology determines labels and validity.
I32 current channels, gain 1000 A; B/C channels are invalid in listed single/split-phase modes.
I32 power quantities: peak active for current day, active, reactive; explicit gain 1000 and kW/kVar units.
I16 dimensionless factor, gain 1000; source unit cell blank.
U16 grid frequency, gain 100 Hz.
U16 percentage, gain 100; scope distinguishes generating from absorbing operation.
I16 internal temperature, gain 10 degrees C.
U16 insulation quantity, gain 1000 MOhm.
One register with literal type E16 at 32089.
U16 fault identifier for the highest-priority alarm, raw code.
Two-register fields use literal EpochSecond, gain 1 s; glossary defines seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00.
U32 quantities with gain 100 kWh: generated energy by cumulative/current/previous periods and total DC input.
U16 counts, gain 1, for critical/major/minor/warning categories.
Raw U16/U32 event sequence identifiers: clear sequence, latest active sequence, latest historical sequence.
I16 voltages, gain 10 V; 32176..32181 scope is PID-reported single-level scenarios.
U16 row carries a V unit but explicit values encode inverter classes: 0, 1500 and 1502.
Bitfield16 ISO feature information, PID/single-level context.
32190/32192 each have literal E16 and length 1.
Four U32 energy counters, gain 100 kWh.
Bitfield16 group registers expose GroupID metadata.
Bitfield32 uses bits 0..15 for support systems 1..16, upper bits reserved.
U32 runtime quantities, gain 10 hour, marked inspection data.
35010 is titled an alarm but typed U16 with gain 1 and unit V.
Twelve I16 temperature fields, gain 10 degrees C. Sensor aggregation/context varies by row.
Three I16 current fields, gain 1000 A; diagnostic recording scope.
I16 residual current, gain 1 mA.
I16 positive/negative/negative-to-ground bus fields, gain 10 V.
Three E16/one-register fields for I-V state/capability and deferred activation.
35300 and 35304 are separate MLD fields, each four registers (eight bytes).
37518 Bitfield16 state and 37519 U16/gain1 support flag are separate fields.
42056 is explicitly RO U32/2, gain1000 kW, despite its location amid control settings.
